title: Sales
description:
Descriptions

Relevant Experience: Proven sales or business development experience in Silicon IP and SoC Design Services and/or in OEM systems industry.
This is a senior-level, position within the North America Sales Team that will focus on developing new businesses and manage existing business at OEM system and semiconductor companies in the North America market.
Qualified candidates must possess a strong ability to develop and build business engagements, comprehend and convey technical customer product requirements, have excellent customer management skills, and proven experience in negotiating and closing major business opportunities.
Candidates must be comfortable working across multi-national team environments.

Requirements

At least 5 years of experience in Silicon IP and SoC Design Services.

Preferred 3 years of direct sales and business development experience.

Proven experience forecasting and achieving quarterly revenue goals.

Ability in structuring, negotiating, and closing contracts for IP and Design Services business.

Excellent communication and teamwork skills.

Self-motivated and results-driven.

Creative business thinking.

Knowledge of end-to-end chip SoC development methods is a strong plus.

Experience with consumer, industrial, or automotive programs a strong plus.

Please submit your resume to
US.HR@verisilicon.com
for consideration.

title: Technical Customer Interface & Success Manager/AE
description:
Descriptions

Serve as the primary technical interface between customers and VeriSilicon internal teams for ASIC, SoC, IP licensing, and turnkey design service engagements

Support pre-sales and post-sales customer activities including technical presentations, solution alignment, proposal reviews, and issue resolution

Work closely with Sales teams to support new business development opportunities in North America

Coordinate with worldwide engineering teams to define schedules, deliverables, resource planning, and project execution milestones

Drive customer core team meetings involving cross-functional engineering teams

Support NPI (New Product Introduction) programs from pre-silicon through qualification and production ramp

Translate customer technical requirements into actionable engineering deliverables

Track and manage project schedules, risks, dependencies, and customer deliverables

Interface with customers on technical topics including:

-
SoC architecture

-
IP integration

-
system performance

-
power optimization

-
die size tradeoffs

-
product qualification

-
manufacturing readiness

Coordinate issue escalation and resolution across engineering, operations, and customer teams

Assist customers with silicon bring-up, validation, and production ramp activities

Support customer presentations, documentation, and technical reviews

Requirements

BSEE a must, MSEE preferred

Preferred 3 years of experience in semiconductor industry with emphasis on:

-
Silicon IP

-
ASIC/SoC development

-
Design Services

-
Semiconductor systems

5+ years of customer-facing experience in:

-
Field Applications Engineering

-
Technical Program Management

-
Customer Engineering

-
Technical Account Management

Strong understanding of end-to-end chip development flow including:

-
architecture

-
RTL design

-
verification

-
physical design

-
packaging

-
silicon validation

-
production ramp

Experience managing complex semiconductor projects in fast-paced global environments

Solid understanding of fabless semiconductor ecosystem and foundry flows

Experience coordinating worldwide hardware/software engineering teams

Strong communication and presentation skills with ability to interface effectively with customers and executives

Ability to manage schedules, priorities, risks, and technical deliverables across multiple programs

Self-directed, motivated, and results-driven

Strong teamwork and cross-functional collaboration skills

Please submit your resume to
US.HR@verisilicon.com
for consideration.
